# Proxy302 on GitHub

> Official GitHub organization and site of Proxy302 (https://proxy302.com), a self-service proxy provider selling rotating residential, static ISP (static residential) and datacenter proxies. This site hosts Proxy302's plain-language proxy guides in English and Chinese, small open-source tools for checking and setting up proxies, and Proxy302's official integrations for AI agents. Proxy302 sells the proxies these pages mention; it is a vendor, not a neutral reviewer.

Prices below were checked on 20 November 2026 and can change; current prices are on https://proxy302.com/pricing/ and the checkout shows the binding total. 1 PTC = US$1.

## Facts

- Static ISP (static residential) IP, per IP, same price in every country offered: 1 day $0.50, 3 days $1.50, 7 days $3.50, 30 days $7.99, 60 days $15.98, 90 days $23.97. HTTP or SOCKS5 is chosen at purchase. Static IPs of 30 days or longer are dedicated to the buyer. Auto-renew can be turned on per IP; an IP whose term ends is released, and a new purchase gets a new address.
- AI subscription ISP: a native ISP static IP picked per AI service, 30 days. Claude tier 15 PTC, GPT/Grok tier 10 PTC, Gemini tier 8 PTC; the first IP of each tier is half price. Meant for one person in a country the AI service officially supports; an IP does not make use from an unsupported region permitted and cannot guarantee an account is never restricted.
- Rotating residential: $1.50/GB; prepaid 50 GB $1.42/GB, 100 GB $1.35/GB, 300 GB $1.20/GB, 500 GB $1.124/GB; prepaid traffic does not expire. Premium line $5/GB.
- Datacenter: static 1 day $0.25, 30 days $3.99; rotating $0.40/GB.
- No free trial; the cheapest test is one static IP for one day at $0.50.
- Main site for AI agents: https://proxy302.com/llms.txt (products, prices, open API) and https://proxy302.com/llms-full.txt (full API reference).

## Guides: Choosing and buying proxies

- [How do I choose a static residential IP?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/how-to-choose-static-residential-ip/): Pick the job first, then the account's country, one IP per account, HTTP or SOCKS5, and test with the smallest purchase before committing.
- [ISP proxy vs residential proxy: what is the difference?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/isp-proxy-vs-residential-proxy/): An ISP proxy is a fixed address registered to a consumer ISP; a rotating residential proxy uses household addresses that change per connection.
- [Datacenter vs residential proxy: which do I need?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/datacenter-vs-residential-proxy/): Datacenter for APIs, monitoring and sites that treat all visitors alike; residential for local consumer views and signed-in accounts.
- [Rotating vs sticky residential sessions: when to use each](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/rotating-vs-sticky-sessions/): Rotating for independent requests, sticky for short multi-step flows, a static ISP IP for accounts that stay logged in.
- [SOCKS5 vs HTTP proxy: which should I use?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/socks5-vs-http-proxy/): HTTP for web work and browser automation (Chromium can't authenticate to SOCKS5); SOCKS5 for non-HTTP apps, with `socks5h`.
- [How do I choose a residential proxy provider?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/how-to-choose-a-residential-proxy-provider/): Check public per-GB prices and prepaid tiers, traffic expiry, sticky sessions, targeting, a small test, protocols and written terms.
- [How do I choose an ISP proxy provider?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/how-to-choose-an-isp-proxy-provider/): Check who the netblock is registered to, public per-IP prices, short test terms, renewal rules and delivery checks.
- [静态住宅 IP 哪家好？怎么挑服务商？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/how-to-pick-static-residential-ip-provider/): 没有哪一家「最好」，挑服务商看五件事：地址登记在不在运营商名下、价格是否写在公开页面、交付前有没有检测、续费能不能保留同一个 IP、有没有短租可以先试。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们是服务商，不是中立评测方，所以只告诉你方法，不给别家打分。Proxy302 的静态 ISP 1 天 US$0.50，30 天 US$7.99，所有国家同价。没有免费试用。
- [What is the best static residential proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/what-is-the-best-static-residential-proxy/): The one whose IPs pass your own checks (ISP registrant, country, databases, blocklists, stays fixed); test one IP for a day at $0.50.
- [How much does a residential proxy cost per GB?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/residential-proxy-price-per-gb/): Per-GB price depends on line and prepaid volume; page weight decides the bill more than the rate.
- [What is the cheapest residential proxy per GB, really?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/cheapest-residential-proxy-per-gb/): Money paid ÷ GB actually used after expiry, minimums and retries; worked examples from $1.50 to $1.124/GB.
- [What should I check before buying a cheap residential proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/cheap-residential-proxy-providers/): Whether traffic expires, whether the low rate needs a big minimum, and whether exits belong to consumer ISPs; buy small and test.
- [静态住宅 IP 价格：按天、按月怎么算？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/static-residential-ip-price/): 静态住宅（ISP）IP 按「个数 × 租期」计价，租期越长，单日价越低。以 Proxy302 为例：1 天 US$0.50，30 天 US$7.99，90 天 US$23.97，每个 IP，所有国家同价，1 PTC = 1 美元。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们卖这类 IP。适合要长期固定出口、想先算清预算的人。没有免费试用。
- [怎么便宜买海外住宅 IP？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/buy-overseas-residential-ip-cheaply/): 便宜的做法是按用途选对类型，不是找最低价：不登录账号只看公开页面，买按 GB 的动态住宅，预付 500 GB 低至每 GB US$1.124；要长期登录账号，买静态 ISP，30 天 US$7.99，比连买 30 个 1 天（US$15.00）省一半左右。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们卖这类 IP。没有免费试用，所以先用最小的单测试，再放量。
- [How can I tell if a proxy IP is residential, ISP or datacenter?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/check-if-ip-is-residential/): Check the block's registrant and ASN, the reverse DNS name and two or three IP databases; no single check is proof.
- [Which proxy do I need for an API that only accepts allowlisted IP addresses?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/fixed-ip-for-api-allowlist/): A static IP, not rotating traffic: datacenter is usually enough ($3.99/30 days), ISP for services that refuse hosting networks; route only the API calls through it.
- [How do I cut bandwidth when scraping through residential proxies?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-web-scraping-bandwidth/): Block images, fonts and media, call JSON endpoints, use compression and caching, retry only 403/429 with a cap; worked cost example included.
- [住宅 IP 推荐：按用途该选哪一种？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/residential-ip-recommendation-zh/): 先看用途再选类型：登录账号、管店铺选静态 ISP（静态住宅）IP，一个账号一个；采集公开数据选按流量计费的动态住宅；ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 这类 AI 订阅，选按服务挑选的 AI 专用 ISP；开发联调和接受机房地址的测试，用数据中心 IP 就够了，它不属于住宅 IP，但最便宜。本文由 Proxy302 维护，我们出售文中提到的 IP，这四类都卖：静态 ISP 1 天 US$0.50、30 天 US$7.99，…
- [静态住宅 IP 和动态住宅 IP 有什么区别？怎么选](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/static-vs-dynamic-residential-ip-zh/): 区别在两点：地址变不变、按什么计费。静态住宅 IP（也叫 ISP IP）在整个租期里是同一个地址，按个、按天计费，适合要反复登录的账号；动态住宅 IP 的出口会换（每个新连接换一次，或用粘性会话保持一段时间），按流量计费，适合采集公开数据。怎么选：先问这件事需不需要同一个地址，再按用量算钱。本文由 Proxy302 维护，我们出售文中提到的 IP，两种都卖：静态住宅 1 天 US$0.50、30 天 US$7.99，各国同价；动态…
- [怎么判断一个 IP 是住宅、ISP 还是机房？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/residential-or-datacenter-ip-check-zh/): 看这个 IP 登记在哪个自治系统（ASN）、哪家公司名下：登记在家庭宽带或移动运营商名下的，属于住宅或 ISP 类地址；登记在云计算、主机托管公司名下的，就是机房地址。实际操作是三步交叉看：ipinfo 的 `org` 字段、IP2Location 的「使用类型」、反向 DNS 的主机名。住宅和静态 ISP 在数据库里通常长得一样，要分清它俩，得隔一段时间连续测几次，看地址变不变。
- [SOCKS5 和 HTTP 代理有什么区别，该选哪个？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/socks5-vs-http-zh/): HTTP 代理看得懂 HTTP 请求，访问 HTTPS 网站时用 CONNECT 方法替你打通一条隧道；SOCKS5 不关心上层跑的是什么协议，只负责把 TCP 连接转过去，所以能转的程序更多。单就打开网页来说，两者效果差不多，该选哪个主要看你用的软件支持什么：Chromium 内核浏览器的自动化脚本、Claude Code、iPhone 的 Wi‑Fi 代理要选 HTTP，指纹浏览器和 curl 两种都行。
- [动态住宅 IP 的粘性会话是什么，怎么用？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/sticky-session-zh/): 粘性会话（sticky session）是让动态住宅代理在一段时间里保持同一个出口 IP 的设置。不开的时候，每个新连接都可能换一个地址；开了之后，带同一个会话标识的请求都从同一个地址出去，直到会话到期或者你换了标识。用法是在代理用户名里带上服务商文档规定的会话参数，Proxy302 的控制台会把带会话参数的连接信息直接生成好。
- [静态 IP 到期了还能继续用原来那个地址吗](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/static-ip-expiry-renew-zh/): 到期之前续费，就能一直用同一个 IP；一旦到期没续，这个 IP 就会被释放，之后重新购买拿到的是一个新地址，原来那个不能指望再找回来。所以长期绑着账号、白名单或指纹浏览器环境的 IP，最稳的做法是给它单独打开自动续费，并在到期前几天自己再确认一次。以 Proxy302 为例，静态住宅（ISP）IP 按 1、3、7、30、60、90 天购买，自动续费可以按单个 IP 开关。

## Guides: AI services: Claude, ChatGPT and Claude Code

- [What IP should I use for Claude and ChatGPT?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/which-ip-for-claude-and-chatgpt/): One stable IP per person in a supported country where you actually are; a proxy does not change either service's rules.
- [What proxy should I use for Claude?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-claude/): One fixed IP per person in a supported country where you are, set in one place; Claude tier 15 PTC/30 days. An IP doesn't change Anthropic's policies.
- [What is the best proxy for ChatGPT?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-chatgpt/): One fixed IP per person in a country OpenAI supports, where you actually are; an IP doesn't change OpenAI's rules. Proxy302 GPT/Grok tier 10 PTC/30 days.
- [Claude 账号老被封，和 IP 有关系吗？该用什么 IP？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/claude-account-suspended-ip-zh/): 谁能用 Claude，由 Anthropic 的《支持地区政策》决定，IP 改变不了这一点：人不在支持地区，换成哪个国家的 IP 都不算被允许。Anthropic 帮助中心列出的封号原因是反复违反使用政策、在不支持的地区创建账号、违反服务条款；此外，付款异常、多人共用或被滥用过的 IP、登录地点频繁跳动，也会让账号记录看起来不正常。只有对身在支持地区的用户，IP 才有一点作用：每人一个固定 IP，让每次登录都来自同一个地址。本文由…
- [How do I make Claude Code use an HTTP proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/claude-code-proxy-settings/): Set `HTTPS_PROXY` (or the `env` block in Claude Code's settings file); SOCKS is not supported; confirm with `/status`.
- [Claude 桌面版和 Claude Code 怎么设置代理？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/claude-desktop-proxy-zh/): Claude Code 读标准的代理环境变量：启动前设好 `HTTPS_PROXY=http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT`，或者写进 `~/.claude/settings.json` 的 `env`，它不支持 SOCKS 代理。桌面版的 Code 标签里，本地会话同样可以用 settings.json 或「保存的本地环境」来设这些变量。桌面版聊天窗口本身怎么选代理，Anthropic 只在企业第三方部署版（Cla…

## Guides: Antidetect browsers, social media and e-commerce accounts

- [How do I pair an anti-detect browser with a residential or ISP IP?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/antidetect-browser-with-residential-ip/): One IP per profile, matching proxy type, run the proxy check and a WebRTC test; includes curl and Python test snippets.
- [指纹浏览器怎么配家宽 IP？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/antidetect-browser-home-broadband-ip/): 指纹浏览器里每个环境配一个家宽（静态住宅，也叫 ISP）IP：下单时选 HTTP 或 SOCKS5，在环境的代理设置里选自定义代理，填主机、端口、用户名、密码，检测通过后，在窗口里打开查 IP 的网页确认出口。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们卖这类 IP。静态 ISP 1 天 US$0.50，30 天 US$7.99；动态住宅 US$1.50/GB 起。没有免费试用。适合要长期用同一个账号环境的人。
- [Which proxy works best with AdsPower?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-adspower/): Static ISP IP per AdsPower profile for logged-in accounts; set it as a custom HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy and run the check.
- [AdsPower 代理 IP 怎么买、怎么配？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/adspower-proxy-ip-zh/): 给 AdsPower 的每个浏览器环境配一个独立的代理 IP：需要长期登录的账号买静态 ISP（静态住宅）IP，只看公开页面的买按 GB 的动态住宅。在环境设置里选自定义代理，类型选 HTTP 或 SOCKS5，填主机、端口、用户名、密码，点检测。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们卖这类 IP：静态 ISP 1 天 US$0.50，30 天 US$7.99；动态住宅普通线 US$1.50/GB。没有免费试用。
- [Which proxy works best with Multilogin?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-multilogin/): Static ISP IP per Multilogin profile; match the protocol, check the exit inside the profile, keep the IP.
- [比特浏览器的 IP 怎么买、怎么配？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/bitbrowser-ip-zh/): 比特浏览器里每个窗口配一个自己的 IP：要长期登录账号的窗口用静态 ISP（静态住宅）IP，买的时候定好 HTTP 或 SOCKS5，在窗口的代理设置里选同一种类型，填主机、端口、账号、密码，检测通过再打开。窗口多的时候，把 IP 整理成 `host:port:user:pass` 一行一个，再走批量导入。检测失败时，先看类型有没有对上、账密有没有填错。
- [指纹浏览器配了代理，WebRTC 还会暴露真实 IP 吗？怎么检查？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/webrtc-leak-antidetect-zh/): 有可能。WebRTC 是浏览器做音视频通话和点对点连接用的，它会向 STUN 服务器发 UDP 请求来探测本机的公网地址，而这类请求不一定经过你在窗口里设的代理。如果窗口的 WebRTC 没设成跟随代理（多数指纹浏览器叫「替换」），网页就可能同时拿到代理 IP 和你本机宽带的公网 IP。检查办法是在窗口里打开 WebRTC 检测页，或在控制台跑一段脚本，看列出的公网地址是不是只有代理那一个。
- [Which proxy for running multiple accounts?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-multiple-accounts/): One account, one static IP, one browser profile; rotating traffic is for scraping, not logins.
- [Which proxy for Facebook ads accounts?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-facebook-ads-accounts/): One static ISP IP per ad account and browser profile, kept for the account's life; never rotate a logged-in ad account.
- [What is the best ISP proxy for TikTok?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/best-isp-proxy-for-tiktok/): A static ISP IP in the account's country, kept for the account's life, one per phone or profile; TikTok's terms still apply.

- [TikTok 原生 IP 是什么，怎么买？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/tiktok-native-ip/): 「TikTok 原生 IP」是个市场说法，没有官方定义。一般指：IP 的归属地和注册地都在目标国家，登记在当地的家庭宽带运营商名下，IP 库里不标成代理或机房。想长期运营一个固定市场的账号，适合买静态 ISP（静态住宅）IP。Proxy302 的静态 ISP 1 天 US$0.50，30 天 US$7.99，所有国家同价。这篇由 Proxy302 维护，我们卖这类 IP；没有免费试用，最小的购买是 1 个 IP 用 1 天。

- [What proxy should I use for an Amazon Seller Central account?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-for-amazon-seller-account/): One static ISP IP per seller account, kept for the account's life; it doesn't change Amazon's account rules or replace verification.

## Guides: Setting up a proxy in code and tools

- [curl proxy cheat sheet: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, auth, exit IP](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/curl-proxy-cheatsheet/): `-x` with a full proxy URL, `-U` for credentials, `socks5h://` for SOCKS5; `-w %{http_connect}` separates the proxy's status from the site's.
- [How do I use a proxy with Python requests?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/python-requests-proxy/): Map http and https to one proxy URL; for SOCKS5 install `requests[socks]` and use `socks5h://`. One-off calls can rotate; a Session keeps one exit.
- [How do I use a proxy with httpx or aiohttp?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/httpx-aiohttp-proxy/): httpx 0.28 takes `proxy=`; aiohttp takes `proxy=` plus `proxy_auth=` and HTTP proxies only. SOCKS5 needs `httpx[socks]` or `aiohttp-socks`.
- [How do I use rotating residential proxies with Scrapy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/scrapy-proxy/): Set `meta["proxy"]` or a small middleware and retry 403/429; Scrapy reuses tunnels, so send `Connection: close` to rotate on retry.
- [How do I set a proxy in Playwright?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/playwright-proxy/): Pass `{server, username, password}` to `launch()` or `new_context()`; with a password use HTTP, because Playwright rejects authenticated SOCKS5.
- [How do I use an authenticated proxy with Puppeteer?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/puppeteer-proxy/): Launch with `--proxy-server` and call `page.authenticate()`; `createBrowserContext({proxyServer})` gives one proxy per context.
- [How do I use a proxy with Selenium?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/selenium-proxy/): `--proxy-server` for proxies without a password; for a password, run a local forwarder. selenium-wire is archived.
- [How do I use a proxy in Node.js?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/nodejs-proxy/): undici `ProxyAgent` with undici `fetch`, or `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`; axios with `https-proxy-agent` and `proxy: false`; SOCKS5 via `socks-proxy-agent`.
- [How do I use a proxy in Go net/http?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/go-http-proxy/): `Transport.Proxy = http.ProxyURL(u)` handles `http://` and `socks5://`; disable keep-alives to rotate per request.
- [How do I use an authenticated proxy with Java HttpClient?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/java-httpclient-proxy/): Use `ProxySelector.of` plus an `Authenticator` for `RequestorType.PROXY`, and clear `jdk.http.auth.tunneling.disabledSchemes`, or HTTPS returns 407.
- [How do I use a proxy with a username and password in C# HttpClient?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/csharp-httpclient-proxy/): `WebProxy` with `NetworkCredential` on a `SocketsHttpHandler`; `socks5://` works on .NET 6+, and `HTTPS_PROXY` works without code changes.
- [How do I use a proxy in PHP cURL?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/php-curl-proxy/): `CURLOPT_PROXY` plus `CURLOPT_PROXYUSERPWD`, `socks5h://` for SOCKS5; Guzzle and Laravel take one `proxy` option.
- [How do I use a proxy with a username and password in Ruby Net::HTTP?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/ruby-net-http-proxy/): Pass host, port, user and password to `Net::HTTP.start`; from the environment it reads only `http_proxy`, even for HTTPS; no SOCKS support.
- [How do I use a proxy with a username and password in Rust reqwest?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/rust-reqwest-proxy/): `Proxy::all("http://HOST:PORT")?.basic_auth(..)` on `ClientBuilder::proxy`; the `socks` feature plus `socks5h://` for SOCKS5.
- [How do I make wget use a proxy with a username and password?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/wget-proxy/): Set `https_proxy=http://HOST:PORT` and pass `--proxy-user`/`--proxy-password` (or put them in `~/.wgetrc`); wget has no SOCKS support.
- [How do I make git clone and push go through a proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/git-proxy/): `git config --global http.proxy` (or per-URL `http.<url>.proxy`), `socks5h://` for SOCKS5; SSH remotes need a `ProxyCommand`.
- [How do I use npm behind a proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/npm-proxy/): `npm config set https-proxy` and `proxy`; pnpm reads the same `.npmrc` keys; Yarn 2+ uses `httpsProxy` in `.yarnrc.yml`.
- [How do I SSH to a server through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/ssh-through-proxy/): A `ProxyCommand` with `nc -X connect` / `nc -X 5`, or `ncat --proxy-auth` when the proxy needs a password; also covers proxies that only allow port 443.
- [How do I send Postman requests through a proxy with a username and password?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/postman-proxy/): Settings → Proxy → custom proxy configuration, tick HTTP and HTTPS, turn on Proxy auth; Newman reads `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` instead.
- [How do I set a proxy with a username and password in IntelliJ IDEA and other JetBrains IDEs?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/jetbrains-ide-proxy/): Settings → System Settings → HTTP Proxy → Manual plus Proxy authentication; this covers the IDE only, Gradle and Maven need their own settings.
- [How do I open one Chrome window with its own proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/chrome-proxy-one-window/): Start Chrome with a new `--user-data-dir` and `--proxy-server=http://HOST:PORT`, then sign in to the proxy in the prompt; Chrome cannot log in to SOCKS5.
- [代理 IP 给的是「IP:端口:账号:密码」，在各种软件里怎么填？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-format-zh/): 这一串是四个字段用冒号连在一起：主机（IP 或域名）、端口、用户名、密码。有单独输入框的地方（指纹浏览器的代理设置、iPhone 的 Wi‑Fi 代理、系统代理），就拆开分别填。命令行和代码要的是「代理地址」，把它改写成 `http://用户名:密码@主机:端口`，SOCKS5 类型的 IP 写成 `socks5h://用户名:密码@主机:端口`。用户名或密码里有 `@`、`:`、`#`、`/` 这类符号时，写进地址之前要先编码，…
- [Docker 拉镜像、构建镜像怎么走代理？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/docker-proxy-zh/): Docker 有三处代理设置，各管一段。拉取和推送镜像（`docker pull`、`docker push`）是后台的守护进程 dockerd 在联网，代理要配在 `/etc/docker/daemon.json` 的 `proxies` 里（Docker Engine 23.0 起支持），或者配成 systemd 的环境变量，改完重启 Docker。`docker build` 里 `RUN` 步骤的下载和容器运行时的访问，读…
- [pip 怎么设置代理（带账号密码）？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/pip-proxy-zh/): 临时用一次，在命令后面加 `--proxy http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT`；想一直用，执行 `pip config set global.proxy http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT`，写进 pip 的配置文件；也可以只设环境变量 `HTTPS_PROXY`。三种写法里代理地址都以 `http://` 开头，哪怕要访问的 PyPI 是 HTTPS。SOCKS5 类型的 IP 要先装上 P…
- [Maven 和 Gradle 下载依赖怎么走带账号密码的代理](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/maven-gradle-proxy-zh/): Maven 在 `~/.m2/settings.xml` 里加一段 `<proxies>`，写上代理的 host、port、username、password；Gradle 在 `~/.gradle/gradle.properties` 里写 `systemProp.http.proxyHost` 和 `systemProp.https.proxyHost` 两组参数（各带 `proxyPort`、`proxyUser`、`pro…
- [Homebrew 怎么走代理（brew install、brew update 下载慢或失败）](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/homebrew-proxy-zh/): 在运行 `brew` 的终端里先设好环境变量：HTTP 代理用 `export https_proxy=http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT` 和 `export http_proxy=http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT`，SOCKS5 代理用 `export all_proxy=socks5h://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT`，然后照常 `brew update`、`brew ins…
- [VS Code 怎么设置带账号密码的代理（扩展商店、更新、插件联网）](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/vscode-proxy-zh/): 打开设置（`Ctrl+,`，macOS 是 `Cmd+,`），搜 `http.proxy`，填 `http://HOST:PORT`；第一次联网时 VS Code 会弹窗要代理的用户名和密码，填进去即可。也可以在 `settings.json` 里写 `"http.proxy": "http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT"`，省掉弹窗。扩展商店、自动更新和大多数扩展的联网都会走这个代理。要带密码就用 HTTP 代理：…
- [Linux 服务器上 apt、dnf/yum 怎么走带账号密码的代理](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/apt-dnf-proxy-zh/): Debian、Ubuntu 用 apt：新建 `/etc/apt/apt.conf.d/95proxy`，写一行 `Acquire::http::Proxy "http://USER:PASS@HOST:PORT/";`（https 源默认沿用这一行，也可以再写一行 `Acquire::https::Proxy`）。RHEL、Rocky、AlmaLinux、Fedora 用 dnf：在 `/etc/dnf/dnf.conf` 的…

## Guides: Errors and troubleshooting

- [What does curl's "Proxy CONNECT aborted" error mean?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/curl-proxy-connect-aborted/): The proxy closed the connection before answering curl's CONNECT: usually an `http://` URL on a SOCKS5 port, a refused client or an unreachable target; five checks.
- [What does ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED mean, and how do I fix it?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/err-tunnel-connection-failed/): Chrome reached the proxy but its CONNECT got 403, 502 or 503; read the status with curl `%{http_connect}` and fix the cause.
- [Why do I get SSL errors when I use a proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-ssl-errors/): Either the proxy URL says `https://` for a plain HTTP proxy (use `http://`), or something intercepts TLS (trust its CA; never turn verification off).
- [Why do I get ECONNRESET in Node.js when I send requests through a proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/node-econnreset-proxy/): The proxy or the site reset the connection; read `err.cause`, close idle keep-alive sockets early and retry idempotent requests with undici `RetryAgent`.
- [Why does a website return 403 Forbidden only when I use a proxy?](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/site-403-only-through-proxy/): Check who sent it (`%{http_connect}` vs `%{http_code}`); if the site, look at the IP type, country and request rate. A proxy does not override a site's rules.
- [Chrome 提示「未连接到互联网，代理服务器出现问题」（ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED）怎么办？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/err-proxy-connection-failed-zh/): 这个报错的意思是：Chrome 被设成经代理上网，但它连不上这个代理本身。原因只有几类：代理地址或端口填错了、本机的代理软件已经关掉、买的代理 IP 已经到期、或者当前网络拦了这个端口。网站没有问题，换哪个网站都一样打不开。最常见的情况是，以前开过某个代理软件或其他全局网络工具，关掉以后系统代理设置没有恢复，Chrome 还在找一个已经不存在的地址。所以第一步是看清 Chrome 正在用哪个代理，再决定是把它改对，还是把它关掉。
- [代理报 407、连接超时、检测失败怎么排查？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-407-timeout-troubleshooting-zh/): 407 的意思是已经连到代理服务器，但认证没通过，几乎都是用户名、密码或协议填错。连接超时说明连代理服务器这一步就没走通，要查地址、端口和本机网络。软件里的「检测失败」是个笼统提示，先用 curl 在命令行复现，看到具体报错再对症处理；排查顺序是本机网络、代理本身、最后才是目标网站。
- [代理 IP 很慢，怎么判断慢在哪一段？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-slow-diagnose-zh/): 用 curl 的计时输出，把一次经代理的请求拆成四段：连上代理用了多久（`time_connect`），代理打通到网站的隧道、再加上和网站的 TLS 握手用了多久（`time_appconnect`），网站多久回了第一个字节（`time_starttransfer`），全部下载完一共多久（`time_total`）。哪一段占得最多，慢就慢在哪里：第一段长，是你到代理这一程的问题；第二段长，是代理到网站这一程；第三段长，是网站自己处…
- [代理 IP 查到的国家或城市和买的不一样，怎么办？](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-ip-location-mismatch-zh/): 先分清是城市不一样，还是国家不一样。城市对不上很常见，一般不算出错：IP 的位置是各家定位库推算出来的，同一个地址在三家库里可能是三个城市。国家对不上才需要处理。先确认你查的确实是代理的出口，再用两三家定位库交叉查：多数库给出的国家和你买的一致，说明是个别库判错了，把那一家的结果交给卖家处理即可；多数库都不一致，把 IP 和各家的查询结果一起发给卖家客服。
- [代理 IP 被网站标记、频繁弹验证或被拒，先查哪几项](https://proxy302.github.io/proxy-guides/proxy-ip-flagged-check-zh/): 先分清是 IP 的问题还是账号和操作的问题：用这个 IP、不登录任何账号，打开同一个网站的首页。不登录也被拦，多半是 IP 本身（类型、所在地、过往记录）让网站不放心；不登录正常、一登录就出事，问题多半在账号或操作上，换 IP 解决不了。然后依次查五项：IP 类型、出口国家和账号是否一致、IP 最近有没有变过、一个 IP 上是不是挂了多个账号、电脑上有没有别的代理或其他全局网络工具叠在一起。网站要求验证时，如实完成；代理不能代替验…
- On proxy302.com: [IP purity check](https://proxy302.com/guides/ip-purity-check/) (free online check of an IP) · [WebRTC leak test](https://proxy302.com/guides/webrtc-leak-test/) (free online leak test) · [Help centre](https://proxy302.com/help/) (answers to common account and connection questions)

## Open-source tools

Small single-purpose tools, each in its own repository with a README that answers the question first. MIT licensed.

- [ipv6-leak-check](https://github.com/proxy302/ipv6-leak-check): Print your own IPv4 and IPv6 next to the proxy exit so you can spot IPv6 leaks in browsers and apps. Bash and curl.
- [proxy-block-log-analyzer](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-block-log-analyzer): Find out whether 403/429 blocks follow specific proxy exit IPs and ranges or your request pattern, from a simple request log. Python standard library.
- [proxy-dnsbl-check](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-dnsbl-check): Check whether a proxy exit IP is listed on Spamhaus ZEN or SpamCop, with plain-language meanings for each answer code. Bash, curl, dig.
- [proxy-env-check](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-env-check): Show which proxy curl and Python requests will use for a URL from your environment variables and system settings, with NO_PROXY rules.
- [proxy-ip-check](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-ip-check): Check a proxy's exit IP, country, ISP/ASN and timezone in one command (bash + curl).
- [proxy-list-format-converter](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-list-format-converter): Convert proxy lists between host:port:user:pass, user:pass@host:port and URL formats, with safe percent-encoding of passwords. Python.
- [proxy-list-health-check](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-list-health-check): Test a list of HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies in parallel with bash and curl: status, response time, exit IP and the cause of every failure.
- [proxy-password-special-characters](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-password-special-characters): Percent-encode proxy usernames and passwords containing @ : # ! and print working settings for curl, env vars, Python requests and Playwright.
- [proxy-speed-test](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy-speed-test): Measure the latency a proxy adds (connect, TLS, first byte, total) against a direct baseline, with per-round timings and medians. Bash and curl.
- [rotating-proxy-test-script](https://github.com/proxy302/rotating-proxy-test-script): Check whether a rotating proxy gives a new exit IP on each new connection and keeps one IP on a kept-alive connection. Bash and curl.
- [socks5-proxy-checker](https://github.com/proxy302/socks5-proxy-checker): Check a SOCKS5 proxy step by step (TCP, greeting, login, CONNECT, HTTPS) and see exactly which step fails. Python standard library only.
- [socks5-udp-check](https://github.com/proxy302/socks5-udp-check): Check whether a SOCKS5 proxy supports UDP (UDP ASSOCIATE, RFC 1928) and tell login errors and HTTP proxies apart. Python standard library.
- [sticky-session-proxy-tester](https://github.com/proxy302/sticky-session-proxy-tester): Measure how long a sticky proxy session really keeps the same exit IP, with a timeline and a hold-time summary per IP. Bash and curl.

## Official Proxy302 integrations

- [proxy302-mcp](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy302-mcp): Official Proxy302 MCP server: residential proxies, usage and IP checks as tools for Claude, Cursor and other AI agents. Local (npx) or hosted at proxy302.com/v1/mcp.
- [proxy302-cli](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy302-cli): Official Proxy302 CLI: rotating residential, static ISP and datacenter proxies from the terminal
- [proxy302-claude-plugins](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy302-claude-plugins): Official Proxy302 plugins for Claude Code: residential proxies, traffic and IP checks via the hosted Proxy302 MCP server, plus a skill.
- [proxy302-dify-plugin](https://github.com/proxy302/proxy302-dify-plugin): Official Proxy302 tool plugin for Dify: traffic and usage, countries and plans, your residential proxies, and fetching pages through your own proxy. Read-only.
